lessons.title: Countable and Uncountable Nouns
lessons.content: Countable nouns can be counted (an apple, two apples). Uncountable nouns cannot be counted (air, rice, water). Identifying whether a noun is countable or uncountable is important for choosing the right articles and quantifiers.

details.explanation: Countable nouns have both singular and plural forms and can be counted with numbers.
details.example: an apple, two apples, three apples / a child, two children
details.burmese: Countable nouns တွေက ရေတွက်နိုင်ပြီး singular နဲ့ plural ပုံစံ နှစ်မျိုးလုံး ရှိပါတယ်။

details.explanation: Uncountable nouns cannot be counted and do not have a plural form.
details.example: air, rice, water, milk, butter, information, furniture
details.burmese: Uncountable nouns တွေက ရေတွက်မရနိုင်ဘဲ plural ပုံစံ မရှိပါ။
